title: Rhode’s record-breaking Sephora Europe launch helps e.l.f. Beauty sales soar 51%
summary: e.l.f. Beauty has upgraded its sales outlook for the full 2027 financial year after the standout second quarter performance, which was helped by the further international expansion of Hailey Bieber’s beauty brand Rhode
